bio: Enjoy a quintessential English treat, and indulge your sweet tooth with Moonfleet Manor's traditional Afternoon Tea.  With their passion for food, the traditional Afternoon Tea has been lovingly crafted with a classic selection of finger sandwiches, homemade scones with preserve and clotted cream, alongside a selection of cakes and sweet treats. Your Afternoon Tea is served with Higgins loose-leaf tea or coffee.  Children's Afternoon Tea is also available priced at £15 per child, which features a selection of treats and is served alongside activity sheets for children to enjoy during service, or to continue the experience at home.  Set on the idyllic Dorset Coast, Moonfleet Manor boasts picturesque views overlooking the world famous Chesil Beach and Fleet Lagoon. This stylish Georgian Manor has been furnished with a variety of unusual antiques and objects from around the world to give it an old colonial feel that provides ideal surroundings to indulge in the Great British tradition of Afternoon Tea.
